name: Your Love 💖
message: Happy 20th Birthday to my sweetest bbyyy Ayu! 🧁♉ You are my strongest Taurus bull and my favorite Moolank 4 magic man. Thank you for protecting me, loving me so hard, and being my home. May this year give you everything your heart desires — I am right beside you always. 💖✨

name: Mom & Dad
message: On October 13th, 2006, you came into our lives, our strong little boy, and made the whole world brighter. We are so endlessly proud of the handsome, hardworking, kind man you have grown to be. Happy Birthday beta! 💖

name: Best Buddy
message: Happy Birthday bhai ♉! From our stupid childhood days to turning 20 today — you've always been the most loyal, solid guy in the crew. Hope this year brings you all the bikes, games, success and happiness you deserve. Party hard! 🎉🏍️

name: Squad
message: Happy Birthday Ayush bhai! 🎂 The Taurus rock of our group, Moolank 4 legend with that magnetic Rahu aura. May 20 bring you endless vibes, trips, success, and all the happiness. Treat pending! 🍕🔥
